messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: QBR orchestra: account-by-account readout + forecast consolidation

Team —

As we lock the QBR queue next week I want a tight, consistent readout for AtlasCloud (DEAL-8741). This thread should become the single source of truth for the account-by-account notes and the consolidated forecast number we'll present to execs on Thursday. High level asks: 

1) Fill the attached QBR-account-template-v4.xlsx for every AtlasCloud business unit you own. Use the tab names exactly (BU, ARR impact, Close probability, Key risks, Ask).
2) Add a short 2–3 line summary per account in the Account-Summaries_TAB_v3.xlsx — the one-line outcome we’ll put on the runbook slide.
3) Update Forecast-Consolidation-v1.csv with your final probability-weighted amounts by EOD Tuesday so finance can reconcile.

Deadline and cadence: please post completed files here or on the Drive link below by 2027-07-27 20:00 UTC. I’ll compile and circulate a draft exec-readout-deck-AtlasCloud.pdf by Wednesday morning for review.

Priority notes for AtlasCloud:
- Major buying center: Platform & Data (PDM = Jared Cole).
- Risk: legal redlines on data residency expected; procurement has pushed decision to Q4 until SOC2 evidence is confirmed.
- Upside: Product has approved a pilot for recommendation API in Prod; potential expansion to three teams if latency tests meet SLOs.

Open asks (who):
- Karthik: synthesize the technical win conditions and any outstanding infra blockers.
- Marissa: reconcile the finance numbers with the customer’s PO cadence.
- Logan: confirm meeting cadence for the exec demo and lock Jared’s availability.

Attachments: QBR-account-template-v4.xlsx (template), Account-Summaries_TAB_v3.xlsx (examples).

Thanks — keep answers short. I’ll escalate anything I see as a red.

—
Tessa Morgan
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: QBR orchestra: account-by-account readout + forecast consolidation

Tessa —

I started filling the template. Quick notes from the technical side (see Account-Summaries_TAB_v3.xlsx attached):

- AtlasCloud / Platform BU — Probability 70% (pilot clearance, dependant on SOC2 doc). Tech blockers: customer requires end-to-end encryption for KV cache; engineering has an open ticket (INF-5524) that’s scheduled for patch next week. If we hit that patch and the latency numbers hold (p50 < 45ms), they sign pilot.

- AtlasCloud / Ads BU — Probability 30% (needs SLA guarantees). Latency testing window scheduled for 2027-08-02; until then keep as upside.

I attached Account-Summaries_TAB_v3.xlsx with the rows I own. I’ll also add a short note in the Drive doc with the kernel-level dependencies so product has visibility.

Karthik
Principal, Applied ML & On-Call
Redwood Inference

2) Procurement timeline — I spoke to the buyer (cc’d): they need SOC2 evidence and a signed DPA before they advance procurement. Expect a two-week review once we hand over artifacts.

I attached Forecast-Consolidation-v1.csv (snapshot) — the final will land in the Drive folder once Karthik and Logan confirm.
